review_notes: Segment 0: Sanskrit śloka lines were preserved as in the raw transcript; no reconstruction of canonical sandhi/wording was attempted. If a canonical edition of the ślokas is required, verify those lines against an authoritative source.
Segment 1: Phrase 'विषाद स्वाद में भले दुखद हो' may contain an ASR ambiguity: 'स्वाद' could be intended by the speaker, or might be 'स्वरूप' or another word. Please verify against the audio.
Segment 1: Term 'अनुभाव' ("उसके अनुभाव दो हैं") could be intended as 'अनुभव' or the Sanskrit technical term 'अनुभाव'. Contextual meaning differs; please verify from the recording.

Segment 2: Sanskrit fragments contain unclear or garbled segments (e.g., 'यथOl्बेनावृतो' and repeated lines). I changed 'यथो' → 'यथा' (medium confidence) and added quoting/punctuation for clarity, but the full Sanskrit passages should be verified by a human reviewer familiar with the canonical text to ensure doctrinal accuracy.

Segment 6: कई संस्कृत वाक्यांश/शब्द (उदा. "वर्तेरन्", "वर्तेथाः", "अनुपश्य यथा पूर्वे प्रतिपश्य तथा परे") अस्पष्ट ASR-आउटपुट प्रतीत होते हैं। मैंने मूल शब्दों को बिना संशोधन के रखा। इन्हें एक संस्कृत/वेदान्त-प्रवीन मानव समीक्षक द्वारा परखा जाना उचित होगा।
Segment 6: कुल मिलाकर परिवर्तन न्यूनतम और उच्च-संभाव्यता वाले सुधारों तक सीमित रखे गए हैं ताकि वक्ता की मौलिक अभिव्यक्ति अविकृत रहे।

Segment 7: वाक्यांश "माने चित्त भी मेरी, पट भी मेरी कर सकते हैं वो" समझने में अस्पष्ट लग रहा है (संभवतः ASR ने यहाँ कुछ शब्द गड़बड़ा दिए हैं)। मैंने इसे मूल रूप में बनाए रखा; कृपया मानव-समिक्षा करें कि वक्ता ने क्या कहा था और क्या यहाँ कोई शब्द-सुधार जरूरी है।

Segment 8: The opening phrase 'शक्ति पर एक अवला नारी पर उन्होंने चाहे जैसे जाने में किया हो' is unclear and may contain ASR errors; it has been preserved as in the raw transcript. Recommend human review to confirm intended wording.

Segment 10: The Sanskrit verse fragment (यस्त्वविज्ञानवान्भवति अयुक्तेन मनसा सदा तस्येन्द्रियाण्यवश्यानि दुष्टाश्वा इव सारथे) was adjusted only for punctuation/flow. Please review against the intended śloka text for exact diacritics, sandhi, or word forms.
Segment 10: Phrases like 'तुला ये है' and some colloquial spoken fragments were left as in the original to preserve speaker style; review if any further standardization is desired.
Segment 11: Opening phrase 'ससरं चापं' appears unclear / possibly mistranscribed; preserved as in raw transcript pending human review.
Segment 11: Phrase 'आकुल ईक्षणम्' retained from raw; could be intended Sanskrit (आकुल-ईक्षणम् / आकुलाक्षम्), please verify from audio or canonical source.
Segment 11: Ending fragment 'न एतत् त्वयि अन्ये उपपद्यते...' seems incomplete or mis-transcribed; retained as in raw for human review.

Segment 12: The term 'हरियोम' appears twice ("पूरे यदुवंश को ही हरियोम कर दिया" and "आप आज अन्याय का पक्ष लोगे तो हरियोम"). Unclear if speaker intended 'हरि ओम्' (a chant/interjection) or another colloquial/exclamatory expression; left as in raw transcript.
Segment 12: No changes made to Sanskrit/Mantra fragments (e.g., 'एतत् न उपपद्यते', 'धर्मसंस्थापनार्थाय', 'यतो धर्मः ततो जयः') beyond minimal punctuation/spacing; preserved original wording as spoken.

Segment 13: The phrase 'उमरा जाएगा' ("...चाहे वो चेहरा भीष्म पितामह का हो, उमरा जाएगा।") appears garbled or mistranscribed and is unclear in meaning. Preserve as in transcript; please verify against audio.

Segment 13: The sequence 'मातुला, ससुरान्स' looks like ASR corruption of relative-term(s). Preserve as in transcript; please verify and correct (e.g., 'मातुला', 'ससुराल' or other) against the recording.
Segment 13: I corrected 'दुर्गलता' to 'दुर्बलता' with medium confidence. Please verify this change against the audio to ensure the speaker's intended word is 'दुर्बलता'.

Segment 14: The sequence 'तुमको ये नाम मिला, दुनिया ने ये नाम दिया तुमको। तुमने स्वयं नहीं लिया, परान तापयति। नस्तु स्वजनान्। परंतप माने क्या? परान, परजनान्, शत्रून् तापयति इति परंतप।' contains several unclear Sanskrit/grammar fragments that may be ASR errors. I preserved the original wording where uncertain; please verify these phrases against the audio/original speaker for doctrinal accuracy.
Segment 14: Phrase 'साधारण दोष... साधारण प्रतिबंध' may be a misrecognition of the speaker's intended Hindi/Sanskrit terms; please confirm original wording.
